facts.fact: Headmistress Miss Jagerson introduces Phil to the assembled staff as the school's new Latin mistress, Miss Philomela Fen.
facts.anchor: is our new Latin mistress, Miss Philomela Fen.

facts.fact: The Head tells Phil that Mirabel Grending teaches history at the school.
The Head identifies Mr Smithson as the school's modern languages teacher and says he is ex-civil service.
facts.anchor: Our modern languages teacher. Ex-civil service

facts.fact: The Head refuses to explain why the previous Latin teacher, Miss Bredon, left, saying she would rather draw a discreet veil over the details.
facts.anchor: I would rather draw a discreet veil over the exact details of her departure

facts.fact: Mr Smithson catches a girl's jabbing hockey stick, twists it out of her grip and thrusts it back into her stomach, knocking her off the window.
facts.anchor: Then he thrust back with it, hitting its owner firmly in the stomach

facts.fact: Phil snatches a cushion and throws it backhand through the broken window, making the girl drop the flask she was about to toss in.
facts.anchor: slung it backhand through the hole in the window

facts.fact: The Head orders the three ringleaders, Lucy, Marcia and Virginia, to bring everyone to her study at half past six that night after supper.
facts.anchor: at half past six tonight after supper

facts.fact: Mr Smithson remarks that the school librarian, Miss Telfer, is on compassionate leave for her fourth grandparent's death in the past year.
